narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On October 15, 2024, at approximately 0950 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a construction site in Ann Arbor, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Guatemala and that he has no documents.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he crossed into Mexico from Guatemala at Tecun Uman in December 2017 and spent several months in Chiapas.
The subject stated that he then crossed the Rio Grande near Eagle Pass, Texas, on 05/22/2018.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
